rationale: Rule-bug false positive, confirmed by reading packages/audit-core/src/rules/directory-mismatch.ts: the 'directory host' compared is the IGOD category-listing page's own URL (e.g. igod.gov.in/sg/AS/categories), not a per-portal deep link IGOD actually points to. This makes the host-mismatch check fire for essentially every portal sourced from IGOD by construction, not because of a real listing discrepancy. Rejected per Rochak Agarwal's decision (2026-09-04) rather than published as a misleading 'directory disagrees with reality' claim. Flagged for a rule/inventory fix in a future session; not a per-portal judgment call.
